preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The length of the input string s must be between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i, len(s)) if s[i:j+1] == s[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all substrings s[i:j+1] that are palindromes, where each pair of start index i and end index j (with i <= j) defines a distinct substring.
The return value is a non-negative integer.
